name: Закладки
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE distinctive, beautiful, production-plausible DESKTOP LANGUAGES SECTION for the Globoox authors landing. Single flat full-width website section, landscape1536×1024. Not a whole site, not a collage or multiple alternatives. No header, hero, footer, team or browser/device chrome.
Reference1 is the selected live hero: use its contemporary editorial typography and refined book-design sensibility; ignore its comparison marker, content and logos. Reference2 is the newly APPROVED closing section: use its dark forest-green base, warm cream lettering/paper, terracotta accents and carefully restrained physical materials. These are STYLE references only. Do not copy their compositions. Design a new composition exactly as described below.
Keep this shared design system: forest-green #2C3B2D edge-to-edge section, warm ivory/parchment #F4F0E8, terracotta #C05A3A or readable peach accents on green, thin rules, Lora-like Cyrillic serif display and Inter-like supporting typography. Natural soft shadows only for physical paper/books. No neon, glassmorphism, blue SaaS styling, decorative plants, flags, generic floating appcards, heavy borders, gratuitous gradients or shiny3Dglobes. Prioritize actual reading hierarchy. Do not add a button, form, language picker, testimonials, statistics, fake partner claims, translations of the language names or explanatory marketing paragraphs. No extra slogan or an isolated G monogram. Keep all13 language names easily readable and visibly grouped by status; upcoming languages must NOT look available.
EXACT CONTENT, each item once (do not duplicate names in headings, books, captions or lists):
Main heading: “Языки перевода”.
Available group label: “Уже доступны”. Exactly FOUR available names: “English”, “Français”, “Español”, “Русский”.
Upcoming group label: “Скоро”. Exactly NINE upcoming names: “Deutsch”, “Italiano”, “Português”, “Türkçe”, “中文”, “日本語”, “한국어”, “العربية”, “فارسی”.
Preserve accents and all scripts correctly. Use at least roughly20px visual language-name size at1536px width. The layout should work as a coherent website section continuing the references, but be clearly different from other arrangements. No tiny scattered soon labels. The image is a design proposal, not a screenshot of current implementation.

DISTINCT COMPOSITION 05:
FOUR LONG BOOKMARKS. Main heading at upperleft, then a label “Уже доступны”. Four tall narrow cream-paper bookmarks hang from a single fine horizontal terracotta rule across the middle; each bookmark carries one available language name horizontally and clearly in forestserif, with different tiny geometric embossed motifs but no additional text. Vary their hanging height slightly, keep names aligned along a common optical line. No full book, no clipart ribbons or tassels. Beneath them, “Скоро” and nine upcoming names form a compact airy3×3 catalogue directly on the green background. The long vertical rhythm of the four bookmarks must be the defining composition.
